prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Preset customization fallback flow during adoption was helpful (+8.0%), though a carousel fallback flow later showed no clear effect.
Interactive wait screen tips and status was helpful (+5.1%), but other wait screen updates (progress bars, notification alerts, status screens) showed no clear effect.
Desktop pet control callout card during the finish step significantly hurt performance (-13.9%), while other finish step changes (copy, verification screens, layout) showed no clear effect.
Sign-in changes (hints, step reordering, single-column layout) and redesigns during path selection or adoption showed no clear effect.
Predictions consistently overestimate measured impact, particularly for expected positive changes.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +5.7% over 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -3.8% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: -1.0% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: -4.0% over 2 test(s)
- finish, layout: +6.3% over 1 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -5.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, new_screen: +3.0% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +2.2% over 3 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +0.2% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, layout: -0.0% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -1.3% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 62.7%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 85.0%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.2%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, reorder] Story Screen Pre-Path Sequence Reorder: Reorder the onboarding sequence so story precedes choose_path to provide context before choosing a setup path. (why: choose_path has a 76.2% conversion rate with high mean duration (514s), suggesting users lack context when choosing.)
1: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Background Rendering Timer Info: Display an active render timer and estimated setup duration component on the waiting screen. (why: The waiting step has a long mean time of 2336s and median of 201s, leading to user dropoff or confusion.)
2: [adoption, copy] Adoption Certificate Name Ownership Copy: Update adoption certificate headline and body text to emphasize pet ownership confirmation and desktop readiness. (why: Adoption is a high-dropoff step (62.7% conversion), requiring clearer reassurance before transitioning to waiting.)
3: [choose_path, incentive] Path Selection Completion Badge Incentive: Add a visual milestone badge to the choose_path screen acknowledging onboarding progress. (why: 23.8% of users abandon the funnel at choose_path.)
4: [finish, notification] Home Intro Desktop Launch Notification Badge: Add a desktop launcher ready notification component to home_intro indicating where the pet resides on the screen. (why: 3 support emails reported users unable to find their pet on desktop after setup.)
5: [finish, layout] Home Intro Two Column Layout: Switch home_intro to a two_column layout presenting pet status alongside simple finishing instructions. (why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% with median time 395s.)

scores.note: Choose_path dropoff is 23.8%, but sequence reordering historically yields neutral or negative results.
Wait screen info updates have consistently shown modest positive lift (+2.2% historical average).
Adoption has high dropoff (37.3%), but simple copy updates rarely drive conversion improvements.
Choose_path redesigns and visual badges have not proven effective in historical tests.
Both funnel data and support emails identify the issue, but desktop callout badges at finish step previously hurt performance (-13.9%).
Finish step has major dropoff (35.2%), and previous finish layout tests showed strong positive lift (+6.3%).
